postText:
Claude watched someone do a task once. Then it could do it.

Not trained. Not prompted 47 times. Just. Shown once.

idk why that one got me but it did. whole week was chaos, Opus 5 beating their own model at half the price, ChatGPT controlling your desktop, Google dropped three models in like a single Tuesday. all of it blurring together.

but the record-a-skill thing felt different. like a different category of different, not just a faster model or a cheaper API call.

i kept thinking about it while building. right now if you want an agent to do something new you're writing prompts, testing, breaking, fixing, crying a little. this is just. show it once. it learns.

that's not a tool anymore ngl. that starts feeling like something else.

still don't know how fragile the skill is after recording. does it hold if context shifts even slightly. does it generalise or just memorise the exact thing it saw. genuinely no idea.

if you've actually tried it curious what broke first.

#AI #BuildingWithAI #AgentDev
